BEGIN;

-- CreateEnum
CREATE TYPE "Plan" AS ENUM ('FREE', 'PAID');

-- CreateEnum
CREATE TYPE "SubscriptionStatus" AS ENUM ('NONE', 'PENDING', 'ACTIVE', 'PAST_DUE', 'ON_HOLD', 'CANCELLED', 'EXPIRED', 'FAILED', 'PAUSED');

-- AlterTable
ALTER TABLE "User" ADD COLUMN     "billingCountry" TEXT,
ADD COLUMN     "billingCurrency" TEXT,
ADD COLUMN     "billingStateVersion" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
ADD COLUMN     "cancelAtPeriodEnd" BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
ADD COLUMN     "currentPeriodEnd" TIMESTAMP(3),
ADD COLUMN     "currentPeriodStart" TIMESTAMP(3),
ADD COLUMN     "dodoCustomerId" TEXT,
ADD COLUMN     "dodoSubscriptionId" TEXT,
ADD COLUMN     "freeTemplateId" TEXT,
ADD COLUMN     "gracePeriodEnd" TIMESTAMP(3),
ADD COLUMN     "grandfatheredUntil" TIMESTAMP(3),
ADD COLUMN     "isAdmin" BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
ADD COLUMN     "isSuspended" BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
ADD COLUMN     "lastActiveAt" TIMESTAMP(3),
ADD COLUMN     "lastBillingEventAt" TIMESTAMP(3),
ADD COLUMN     "plan" "Plan" NOT NULL DEFAULT 'FREE',
ADD COLUMN     "planOverride" "Plan",
ADD COLUMN     "planOverrideExpiresAt" TIMESTAMP(3),
ADD COLUMN     "planOverrideReason" TEXT,
ADD COLUMN     "planOverrideStartsAt" TIMESTAMP(3),
ADD COLUMN     "subscriptionStatus" "SubscriptionStatus" NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NONE',
ADD COLUMN     "suspendedAt" TIMESTAMP(3),
ADD COLUMN     "suspensionReason" TEXT;

-- CreateTable
CREATE TABLE "BillingSubscription" (
    "id" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "userId" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "dodoSubscriptionId" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "dodoCustomerId" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "productId" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "status" "SubscriptionStatus" NOT NULL,
    "periodStart" TIMESTAMP(3),
    "periodEnd" TIMESTAMP(3),
    "gracePeriodEnd" TIMESTAMP(3),
    "cancelAtPeriodEnd" BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    "currency" TEXT,
    "billingCountry" TEXT,
    "recurringAmountMinor" INTEGER,
    "lastEventAt" TIMESTAMP(3),
    "createdAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    "updatedAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL,

    CONSTRAINT "BillingSubscription_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
);

-- CreateTable
CREATE TABLE "CheckoutAttempt" (
    "id" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "userId" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "idempotencyKey" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "productId" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "billingCountry" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "billingCurrency" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "dodoSessionId" TEXT,
    "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'CREATING',
    "expiresAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL,
    "createdAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,

    CONSTRAINT "CheckoutAttempt_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
);

-- CreateTable
CREATE TABLE "BillingWebhookEvent" (
    "id" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "webhookId" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "eventType" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "businessId" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "subscriptionId" TEXT,
    "customerId" TEXT,
    "paymentId" TEXT,
    "occurredAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL,
    "receivedAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    "processedAt" TIMESTAMP(3),
    "nextAttemptAt" TIMESTAMP(3),
    "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    "processingVersion" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    "state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'RECEIVED',
    "normalizedData" JSONB NOT NULL,
    "payloadHash" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "failureCode" TEXT,

    CONSTRAINT "BillingWebhookEvent_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
);

-- CreateTable
CREATE TABLE "AdminAuditLog" (
    "id" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "actorUserId" TEXT,
    "targetUserId" TEXT,
    "actorIdSnapshot" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "targetIdSnapshot" TEXT,
    "action" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "requestId" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "reason" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "before" JSONB NOT NULL,
    "after" JSONB NOT NULL,
    "createdAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,

    CONSTRAINT "AdminAuditLog_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
);

-- CreateTable
CREATE TABLE "SystemControl" (
    "id" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "key" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "sendingEnabled" BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    "paidGatingEnabled" BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    "updatedAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL,

    CONSTRAINT "SystemControl_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
);

-- CreateIndex
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "BillingSubscription_dodoSubscriptionId_key" ON "BillingSubscription"("dodoSubscriptionId");

-- CreateIndex
CREATE INDEX "BillingSubscription_userId_createdAt_idx" ON "BillingSubscription"("userId", "createdAt");

-- CreateIndex
CREATE INDEX "BillingSubscription_status_periodEnd_idx" ON "BillingSubscription"("status", "periodEnd");

-- CreateIndex
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "CheckoutAttempt_dodoSessionId_key" ON "CheckoutAttempt"("dodoSessionId");

-- CreateIndex
CREATE INDEX "CheckoutAttempt_userId_status_expiresAt_idx" ON "CheckoutAttempt"("userId", "status", "expiresAt");

-- CreateIndex
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "CheckoutAttempt_userId_idempotencyKey_key" ON "CheckoutAttempt"("userId", "idempotencyKey");

-- CreateIndex
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "BillingWebhookEvent_webhookId_key" ON "BillingWebhookEvent"("webhookId");

-- CreateIndex
CREATE INDEX "BillingWebhookEvent_state_nextAttemptAt_receivedAt_idx" ON "BillingWebhookEvent"("state", "nextAttemptAt", "receivedAt");

-- CreateIndex
CREATE INDEX "BillingWebhookEvent_subscriptionId_occurredAt_idx" ON "BillingWebhookEvent"("subscriptionId", "occurredAt");

-- CreateIndex
CREATE INDEX "BillingWebhookEvent_customerId_occurredAt_idx" ON "BillingWebhookEvent"("customerId", "occurredAt");

-- CreateIndex
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "AdminAuditLog_requestId_key" ON "AdminAuditLog"("requestId");

-- CreateIndex
CREATE INDEX "AdminAuditLog_targetUserId_createdAt_idx" ON "AdminAuditLog"("targetUserId", "createdAt");

-- CreateIndex
CREATE INDEX "AdminAuditLog_actorUserId_createdAt_idx" ON "AdminAuditLog"("actorUserId", "createdAt");

-- CreateIndex
CREATE INDEX "AdminAuditLog_action_createdAt_idx" ON "AdminAuditLog"("action", "createdAt");

-- CreateIndex
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "SystemControl_key_key" ON "SystemControl"("key");

-- CreateIndex
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "User_dodoCustomerId_key" ON "User"("dodoCustomerId");

-- CreateIndex
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "User_dodoSubscriptionId_key" ON "User"("dodoSubscriptionId");

-- CreateIndex
CREATE INDEX "User_plan_subscriptionStatus_createdAt_id_idx" ON "User"("plan", "subscriptionStatus", "createdAt", "id");

-- CreateIndex
CREATE INDEX "User_isSuspended_createdAt_id_idx" ON "User"("isSuspended", "createdAt", "id");

-- CreateIndex
CREATE INDEX "User_currentPeriodEnd_idx" ON "User"("currentPeriodEnd");

-- CreateIndex
CREATE INDEX "User_gracePeriodEnd_idx" ON "User"("gracePeriodEnd");

-- CreateIndex
CREATE INDEX "User_lastActiveAt_idx" ON "User"("lastActiveAt");

-- AddForeignKey
ALTER TABLE "BillingSubscription" ADD CONSTRAINT "BillingSubscription_userId_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("userId") REFERENCES "User"("id") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE;

-- AddForeignKey
ALTER TABLE "CheckoutAttempt" ADD CONSTRAINT "CheckoutAttempt_userId_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("userId") REFERENCES "User"("id") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE;

-- AddForeignKey
ALTER TABLE "AdminAuditLog" ADD CONSTRAINT "AdminAuditLog_actorUserId_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("actorUserId") REFERENCES "User"("id") ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE;

-- AddForeignKey
ALTER TABLE "AdminAuditLog" ADD CONSTRAINT "AdminAuditLog_targetUserId_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("targetUserId") REFERENCES "User"("id") ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE;

-- Application invariants maintained explicitly in migrations.
ALTER TABLE "User"
  ADD CONSTRAINT "User_period_bounds_check" CHECK (("currentPeriodStart" IS NULL AND "currentPeriodEnd" IS NULL) OR ("currentPeriodStart" IS NOT NULL AND "currentPeriodEnd" IS NOT NULL AND "currentPeriodEnd" > "currentPeriodStart")),
  ADD CONSTRAINT "User_grace_bounds_check" CHECK ("gracePeriodEnd" IS NULL OR ("currentPeriodEnd" IS NOT NULL AND "gracePeriodEnd" >= "currentPeriodEnd")),
  ADD CONSTRAINT "User_billing_version_check" CHECK ("billingStateVersion" >= 0),
  ADD CONSTRAINT "User_country_check" CHECK ("billingCountry" IS NULL OR "billingCountry" ~ '^[A-Z]{2}$'),
  ADD CONSTRAINT "User_currency_check" CHECK ("billingCurrency" IS NULL OR "billingCurrency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$'),
  ADD CONSTRAINT "User_override_check" CHECK (("planOverride" IS NULL AND "planOverrideStartsAt" IS NULL AND "planOverrideExpiresAt" IS NULL AND "planOverrideReason" IS NULL) OR ("planOverride" IS NOT NULL AND "planOverrideStartsAt" IS NOT NULL AND "planOverrideReason" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("planOverrideReason")) > 0 AND ("planOverrideExpiresAt" IS NULL OR "planOverrideExpiresAt" > "planOverrideStartsAt"))),
  ADD CONSTRAINT "User_suspension_check" CHECK ((NOT "isSuspended" AND "suspendedAt" IS NULL AND "suspensionReason" IS NULL) OR ("isSuspended" AND "suspendedAt" IS NOT NULL AND "suspensionReason" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("suspensionReason")) > 0));

-- Application invariants maintained explicitly in migrations.
ALTER TABLE "BillingSubscription"
  ADD CONSTRAINT "BillingSubscription_period_bounds_check" CHECK (("periodStart" IS NULL AND "periodEnd" IS NULL) OR ("periodStart" IS NOT NULL AND "periodEnd" IS NOT NULL AND "periodEnd" > "periodStart")),
  ADD CONSTRAINT "BillingSubscription_grace_bounds_check" CHECK ("gracePeriodEnd" IS NULL OR ("periodEnd" IS NOT NULL AND "gracePeriodEnd" >= "periodEnd")),
  ADD CONSTRAINT "BillingSubscription_amount_check" CHECK ("recurringAmountMinor" IS NULL OR "recurringAmountMinor" >= 0),
  ADD CONSTRAINT "BillingSubscription_currency_check" CHECK ("currency" IS NULL OR "currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$'),
  ADD CONSTRAINT "BillingSubscription_country_check" CHECK ("billingCountry" IS NULL OR "billingCountry" ~ '^[A-Z]{2}$');

-- Application invariants maintained explicitly in migrations.
ALTER TABLE "CheckoutAttempt"
  ADD CONSTRAINT "CheckoutAttempt_expiry_check" CHECK ("expiresAt" > "createdAt"),
  ADD CONSTRAINT "CheckoutAttempt_country_check" CHECK ("billingCountry" ~ '^[A-Z]{2}$'),
  ADD CONSTRAINT "CheckoutAttempt_currency_check" CHECK ("billingCurrency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$'),
  ADD CONSTRAINT "CheckoutAttempt_status_check" CHECK (length(btrim("status")) > 0);

-- Application invariants maintained explicitly in migrations.
ALTER TABLE "BillingWebhookEvent"
  ADD CONSTRAINT "BillingWebhookEvent_attempts_check" CHECK ("attempts" >= 0),
  ADD CONSTRAINT "BillingWebhookEvent_processing_version_check" CHECK ("processingVersion" >= 1),
  ADD CONSTRAINT "BillingWebhookEvent_state_check" CHECK (length(btrim("state")) > 0),
  ADD CONSTRAINT "BillingWebhookEvent_data_check" CHECK (jsonb_typeof("normalizedData") = 'object'),
  ADD CONSTRAINT "BillingWebhookEvent_hash_check" CHECK ("payloadHash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$');

-- Application invariants maintained explicitly in migrations.
ALTER TABLE "AdminAuditLog"
  ADD CONSTRAINT "AdminAuditLog_actor_snapshot_check" CHECK (length(btrim("actorIdSnapshot")) > 0),
  ADD CONSTRAINT "AdminAuditLog_target_snapshot_check" CHECK ("targetUserId" IS NULL OR ("targetIdSnapshot" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("targetIdSnapshot")) > 0)),
  ADD CONSTRAINT "AdminAuditLog_action_check" CHECK (length(btrim("action")) > 0),
  ADD CONSTRAINT "AdminAuditLog_reason_check" CHECK (length(btrim("reason")) > 0),
  ADD CONSTRAINT "AdminAuditLog_before_check" CHECK (jsonb_typeof("before") = 'object'),
  ADD CONSTRAINT "AdminAuditLog_after_check" CHECK (jsonb_typeof("after") = 'object');

-- Application invariants maintained explicitly in migrations.
ALTER TABLE "SystemControl"
  ADD CONSTRAINT "SystemControl_global_key_check" CHECK ("key" = 'global');

INSERT INTO "SystemControl" ("id", "key", "sendingEnabled", "paidGatingEnabled", "updatedAt")
VALUES (gen_random_uuid()::text, 'global', true, false, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP);

COMMIT;
